This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

You can check the running version by calling the health endpoint, GET /health (or /api/v1/health) — it returns a JSON body including a `version` field, as documented in docs/API.md. No code change is needed here.

Note: I haven't closed the other issue numbers you listed (#4203, #4206, #4304, #4313, #4406); each of those should be reviewed and closed individually by whoever triages them, since this issue's comment only covers #4631.
